prophet.line: And the sign said, "The words of the prophets
stanza: And the people bowed and prayed
To the neon god they made
And the sign flashed out its warning
In the words that it was forming
And the sign said, "The words of the prophets
Are written on the subway walls
And whispered in the sound of silence"
And tomorrow we might not be together
Lord, I don't know nature's way
So I'll try to see into your eyes right now
'Cause these are the good old days

profit.line: Through the sharing of the profits
stanza: He has seen her at the office
With her name on all his papers
Through the sharing of the profits
He will find it hard to shake her from his memory
And she's so busy being free
